definition.title: Discover community demand and intent
definition.description: Scan public online communities (Reddit, Hacker News, GitHub Discussions, forums) for active customer problems, evaluate genuine buying intent, and draft platform-tailored responses for review.

human_review.reason: Community outreach requires founder verification of author context, platform etiquette, and value-first tone.
human_review.summary: Verified community demand opportunities with platform-tailored response drafts. Never contacts anyone automatically.
human_review.queue_clause: Community demand opportunities waiting for review

problem_statement.title: Problem or job-to-be-done
problem_statement.description: What specific friction, technical limitation, or workflow bottleneck does your product solve?

target_customer.title: Target customer persona
target_customer.description: Who experiences this problem? (e.g. 'DevOps engineers managing Kubernetes clusters', 'Solo founders handling billing')

competitors_or_alternatives.title: Competitors or incumbent tools (optional)
competitors_or_alternatives.description: Comma-separated tools people switch from, complain about, or seek alternatives to (e.g. 'Datadog, New Relic')

platforms.title: Platforms to monitor
platforms.description: Target communities: reddit, hacker_news, github_discussions, technical_forums

lookback_days.title: Recency window (days)
lookback_days.description: How many days back to search for discussions.

max_opportunities.title: Maximum opportunities to draft
max_opportunities.description: Maximum number of high-intent opportunities to draft.
